title: Countries explore strategic Bitcoin reserve policies
content: TL;DR: Nation-states are quietly evaluating Bitcoin as a strategic reserve asset, a profound shift from traditional monetary policy. This growing interest underscores Bitcoin's unparalleled security, evidenced by a robust 910.61 EH/s hashrate and 146.47 T difficulty, reinforcing its role as the ultimate hard money. Transactors should prepare for potential long-term shifts in market dynamics and prioritize self-custody as global capital seeks censorship-resistant value.
author: Al Ingle
